5.21.d:
एवं तस्य व्रतस्थस्य षण्मासा दिवसैस्त्रिभिः ..
हीनाः स्युर्ब्राह्मणेंद्राणां नमस्कारपरस्य च .. 19 ..
एतस्मिन्नंतरे प्राप्ता अग्नि तीर्थपरायणाः ..
सप्तर्षयः स्थितो यत्र मार्कंडो धृतमेखलः .. 19 ..
5.21.m:
In this way, as he remained firm in his vow and intent on bowing to the foremost brahmins, / six months minus three days passed. // 18
In the meantime, the seven seers, devoted to Agnitīrtha, / arrived at the place where Mārkaṇḍa was, wearing his girdle. // 19

5.21.s:
tāndṛṣṭvā sa munīnsarvānnamaścakre muneḥ sutaḥ ..
dīrghāyurbhava tairuktaḥ sarvairapi pṛthakpṛthak .. 6.21.20 ..
5.21.d:
तान्दृष्ट्वा स मुनीन्सर्वान्नमश्चक्रे मुनेः सुतः ..
दीर्घायुर्भव तैरुक्तः सर्वैरपि पृथक्पृथक् .. 6.21.20 ..
5.21.m: Seeing all those sages, the son of the sage bowed down. / 'May you be long-lived!' he was told by all of them individually. // 20

5.21.s:
atha taṃ bālabhāvena kautukādbrahmacāriṇaḥ ..
ciraṃ dṛṣṭvā'bravīdvākyaṃ vasiṣṭho munipuṃgavaḥ .. 21 ..
5.21.d:
अथ तं बालभावेन कौतुकाद्ब्रह्मचारिणः ..
चिरं दृष्ट्वाऽब्रवीद्वाक्यं वसिष्ठो मुनिपुंगवः .. 21 ..
5.21.m: Then, having looked for a long time at that celibate student because of his childish nature, out of curiosity, / Vasiṣṭha, the foremost of sages, uttered these words: // 21

5.21.s:
sarvaireṣa śiśuḥ prokto dīrghā yuriti sādaram..
tṛtīye'hni punaḥ prāṇāṃstyakṣyatyayamasaṃśayaḥ .. 22 ..
5.21.d:
सर्वैरेष शिशुः प्रोक्तो दीर्घा युरिति सादरम्..
तृतीयेऽह्नि पुनः प्राणांस्त्यक्ष्यत्ययमसंशयः .. 22 ..
5.21.m: "This child has been respectfully told by all: 'May you be long-lived!' / Yet on the third day he will undoubtedly give up his life. // 22

5.21.s:
tanna yuktaṃ bhavedīdṛgasmākaṃ vacanaṃ dvijāḥ ..
tasmāttatkriyatāṃ karma yenāyaṃ syāccirāyudhṛk .. 23 ..
5.21.d:
तन्न युक्तं भवेदीदृगस्माकं वचनं द्विजाः ..
तस्मात्तत्क्रियतां कर्म येनायं स्याच्चिरायुधृक् .. 23 ..
5.21.m: Therefore such a word of ours would not be fitting, O twice-born; / let that action be taken whereby he may possess a long life." // 23

5.21.s:
tato mithaḥ samālocya sarve te munipuṃgavāḥ ..
procurna jīvanopāyo bhavenmuktvā pitāmaham .. 24 ..
5.21.d:
ततो मिथः समालोच्य सर्वे ते मुनिपुंगवाः ..
प्रोचुर्न जीवनोपायो भवेन्मुक्त्वा पितामहम् .. 24 ..
5.21.m: Then, having deliberated among themselves, all those eminent sages / said, "There can be no means of survival except the Grandfather. // 24

5.21.s:
tasmāttasya puro nītvā bālo'yaṃ kṣīṇajīvitaḥ ..
kriyatāṃ tasya vākyena yathā syāccirajīvabhāk .. 25 ..
5.21.d:
तस्मात्तस्य पुरो नीत्वा बालोऽयं क्षीणजीवितः ..
क्रियतां तस्य वाक्येन यथा स्याच्चिरजीवभाक् .. 25 ..
5.21.m: Therefore, bringing this boy whose life is exhausted before him, / let it be done by his word so that he may enjoy a long life." // 25

5.21.s:
tatastu te samādāya satvaraṃ brahmacāriṇam ..
brahmalokaṃ samājagmustyaktvā tīrthaparākramam .. 26 ..
5.21.d:
ततस्तु ते समादाय सत्वरं ब्रह्मचारिणम् ..
ब्रह्मलोकं समाजग्मुस्त्यक्त्वा तीर्थपराक्रमम् .. 26 ..
5.21.m: Then, quickly taking along the celibate student, / they left their journey of the tīrtha and went to the world of Brahmā. // 26

5.21.s:
tataḥ praṇamya taṃ devaṃ vedoktaiḥ stavanairdvijāḥ ..
stutvā'tha saṃvidhe tasya niṣedustadanantaram .. 27 ..
5.21.d:
ततः प्रणम्य तं देवं वेदोक्तैः स्तवनैर्द्विजाः ..
स्तुत्वाऽथ संविधे तस्य निषेदुस्तदनन्तरम् .. 27 ..
5.21.m: Then, bowing to that god and praising him with Vedic hymns, / the twice-born sat down immediately afterward in his presence. // 27

5.21.s:
teṣāmanaṃtaraṃ so'pi namaścakre pitāmaham ..
bālaḥ proktaśca dīrghāyurbhaveti ca svayaṃbhuvā .. 28 ..
5.21.d:
तेषामनंतरं सोऽपि नमश्चक्रे पितामहम् ..
बालः प्रोक्तश्च दीर्घायुर्भवेति च स्वयंभुवा .. 28 ..
5.21.m: After them, the boy too bowed to the Grandfather, / and was told by the self-manifest one: "May you be long-lived!" // 28

5.21.s:
athovāca munīnsarvānviśrāṃtānpadmayonijaḥ ..
kuto yūyaṃ samāyātāḥ sāṃprataṃ kena hetunā .. 29 ..
5.21.d:
अथोवाच मुनीन्सर्वान्विश्रांतान्पद्मयोनिजः ..
कुतो यूयं समायाताः सांप्रतं केन हेतुना .. 29 ..
5.21.m: Then the lotus-born spoke to all the rested sages: / "From where have you now come, and for what reason? // 29

5.21.s:
procyatāṃ cāpi yatkṛtyaṃ yuṣmākaṃ kriyate'dhunā ..
madgṛhe saṃprayātānāṃ ko'yaṃ bālo'pi sadvratī .. 6.21.30 ..
5.21.d:
प्रोच्यतां चापि यत्कृत्यं युष्माकं क्रियतेऽधुना ..
मद्गृहे संप्रयातानां कोऽयं बालोऽपि सद्व्रती .. 6.21.30 ..
5.21.m: And tell what duty of yours who have arrived at my home / should be done now; also, who is this boy of noble vows?" // 30

5.21.s:
.. munaya ūcuḥ .. ..
tīrthayātrāprasaṃgena bhramamāṇā mahītalam ḥ.
camatkārapurābhyāśe vayaṃ prāptāḥ pitāmaha .. 31 ..
5.21.d:
.. मुनय ऊचुः .. ..
तीर्थयात्राप्रसंगेन भ्रममाणा महीतलम् ः.
चमत्कारपुराभ्याशे वयं प्राप्ताः पितामह .. 31 ..
5.21.m: The sages said: / "While wandering over the surface of the earth in the course of a pilgrimage to tīrthas, / we arrived in the vicinity of Camatkārapura, O Grandfather. // 31

5.21.s:
tatrānena vayaṃ deva bālakenā'bhivāditāḥ ..
kramātsarverapi prokto dīrghāyuriti sādaram .. 32 ..
5.21.d:
तत्रानेन वयं देव बालकेनाऽभिवादिताः ..
क्रमात्सर्वेरपि प्रोक्तो दीर्घायुरिति सादरम् .. 32 ..
5.21.m: There we were greeted respectfully by this boy, O god; / in turn, he was respectfully told by all of us: 'May you be long-lived!' // 32

5.21.s:
etasya tu punaḥ śeṣamāyuṣo divasatra yam ..
vidyate vibudhaśreṣṭha vrīḍitāstena vai vayam .. 33 ..
5.21.d:
एतस्य तु पुनः शेषमायुषो दिवसत्र यम् ..
विद्यते विबुधश्रेष्ठ व्रीडितास्तेन वै वयम् .. 33 ..
5.21.m: Yet the remainder of his life is only three days, / O best of gods; we are truly ashamed because of that. // 33

5.21.s:
tataścainaṃ samādāya vayaṃ prāptāstavāṃtikam ..
bhavatā'pi tathā prokto dīrdhāyu rbālako'stvayam .. 34 ..
5.21.d:
ततश्चैनं समादाय वयं प्राप्तास्तवांतिकम् ..
भवताऽपि तथा प्रोक्तो दीर्धायु र्बालकोऽस्त्वयम् .. 34 ..
5.21.m: Therefore, taking him along, we have arrived in your presence; / you too have spoken likewise: 'May this boy be long-lived!' // 34

5.21.s:
tasmādyathā vayaṃ satyā bhavatā saha padmaja ..
bhavāma kuru tatkṛtyametasmādāgatā vayam .. 35 ..
5.21.d:
तस्माद्यथा वयं सत्या भवता सह पद्मज ..
भवाम कुरु तत्कृत्यमेतस्मादागता वयम् .. 35 ..
5.21.m: Therefore, O lotus-born, perform that act so that we, together with you, / may be truthful. For this reason we have come." // 35

5.21.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
teṣāṃ tadvacanaṃ śrutvā munīnāṃ padmasaṃbhavaḥ ..
provāca prahasanvākyaṃ samādāya ca bālakam .. 36 ..
5.21.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
तेषां तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा मुनीनां पद्मसंभवः ..
प्रोवाच प्रहसन्वाक्यं समादाय च बालकम् .. 36 ..
5.21.m: Sūta said: / Hearing that speech of the sages, the lotus-born, / smiling, took the boy and spoke these words: // 36

5.21.s:
matprasādādayaṃ bālojarāmṛtyuvi varjitaḥ ..
bhaviṣyati na saṃdeho vedavidyāvicakṣaṇaḥ .. 37 ..
5.21.d:
मत्प्रसादादयं बालोजरामृत्युवि वर्जितः ..
भविष्यति न संदेहो वेदविद्याविचक्षणः .. 37 ..
5.21.m: "By my favor, this boy will be free from old age and death; / there is no doubt he will be proficient in Vedic learning. // 37

5.21.s:
tasmātprāgdharaṇīpṛṣṭhaṃ vrajadhvaṃ munisattamāḥ ..
bālamenaṃ samādāya tasminnevāsya maṃdiraṃ .. 38 ..
5.21.d:
तस्मात्प्राग्धरणीपृष्ठं व्रजध्वं मुनिसत्तमाः ..
बालमेनं समादाय तस्मिन्नेवास्य मंदिरं .. 38 ..
5.21.m: Therefore, O best of sages, go first to the surface of the earth / taking this boy to that very dwelling of his, // 38

5.21.s:
yāvadasya pitā vṛddhaḥ putradarśanavihvalaḥ ..
na yāti nidhanaṃ sārdhaṃ dharmapatnyā dvijottamāḥ .. 39. ..
athā''yātāśca taṃ bālaṃ sarve te muni sattamāḥ ..
āgatya vasudhāpṛṣṭhaṃ tasyaivāśramasaṃnidhau .. 6.21.40 ..
5.21.d:
यावदस्य पिता वृद्धः पुत्रदर्शनविह्वलः ..
न याति निधनं सार्धं धर्मपत्न्या द्विजोत्तमाः .. 39. ..
अथा'ऽयाताश्च तं बालं सर्वे ते मुनि सत्तमाः ..
आगत्य वसुधापृष्ठं तस्यैवाश्रमसंनिधौ .. 6.21.40 ..
5.21.m: before his aged father, distraught at not seeing his son, / meets his death together with his lawful wife, O best of the twice-born!" / Then all those best of sages, taking that boy, / came to the surface of the earth, near his very hermitage; // 39–40ab

5.21.s:
amuṃcannagnitīrthe taṃ samābhāṣya tataḥ param ..
tīrthayātrākṛte paścājjagmuranyatra satvaram .. .. 41 ..
5.21.d:
अमुंचन्नग्नितीर्थे तं समाभाष्य ततः परम् ..
तीर्थयात्राकृते पश्चाज्जग्मुरन्यत्र सत्वरम् .. .. 41 ..
5.21.m: they left him at Agnitīrtha after speaking to him, / and then quickly went elsewhere for the sake of their pilgrimage to tīrthas. // 40cd–41

5.21.s:
etasminnaṃtare vipro mṛkaṃḍaḥ sutavatsalaḥ ..
nāpaśyatsvasutaṃ paścādvilalāpa suduḥkhitaḥ .. 42 ..
5.21.d:
एतस्मिन्नंतरे विप्रो मृकंडः सुतवत्सलः ..
नापश्यत्स्वसुतं पश्चाद्विललाप सुदुःखितः .. 42 ..
5.21.m: In the meantime, the brahmin Mṛkaṇḍu, affectionate toward his son, / did not see his son, and subsequently lamented, deeply distressed: // 42

5.21.s:
aho me tanayo'bhīṣṭaḥ kathamadya na dṛśyate..
kūpāṃtaḥ patitaḥ kiṃ nu kiṃ vyālairvā nipātitaḥ .. 43 ..
5.21.d:
अहो मे तनयोऽभीष्टः कथमद्य न दृश्यते..
कूपांतः पतितः किं नु किं व्यालैर्वा निपातितः .. 43 ..
5.21.m: "Alas! Why is my beloved son not seen today? / Has he fallen into a well, or has he been struck down by serpents? // 43

5.21.s:
kṛtvā māṃ duḥkhasaṃtaptaṃ mātaraṃ cāpi putrakaḥ ..
prasthito dīrghamadhvānaṃ viruddhaṃ kṛtavānvidhiḥ .. .. 44 ..
5.21.d:
कृत्वा मां दुःखसंतप्तं मातरं चापि पुत्रकः ..
प्रस्थितो दीर्घमध्वानं विरुद्धं कृतवान्विधिः .. .. 44 ..
5.21.m: Having plunged me and his mother into burning grief, / my little son has departed on the long road; Fate has acted against me! // 44

5.21.s:
paśya brāhmaṇi pāpena mayā duṣkṛtakāriṇā ..
na bālasya mukhaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ prasthitasya yamālaye ..45..
5.21.d:
पश्य ब्राह्मणि पापेन मया दुष्कृतकारिणा ..
न बालस्य मुखं दृष्टं प्रस्थितस्य यमालये ..45..
5.21.m: Look, O brahmin lady: sinful as I am, an evildoer, / I did not see the face of the boy as he set out for the abode of Yama! // 45

5.21.s:
kathitaṃ jñāninā tena mama pūrvaṃ mahātma nā ..
ṣaṅbhirmāsaiḥ sutaste'yaṃ dehatyāgaṃ kariṣyati .. 46 ..
5.21.d:
कथितं ज्ञानिना तेन मम पूर्वं महात्म ना ..
षङ्भिर्मासैः सुतस्तेऽयं देहत्यागं करिष्यति .. 46 ..
5.21.m: It was told to me previously by that great-souled wise man: / 'In six months your son will abandon his body.' // 46

5.21.s:
so'haṃ putrasya duḥkhena sādhayiṣye hutāśanam ..
yāvacchokāgninā kāyo dahyate na varāna ne .. 47 ..
5.21.d:
सोऽहं पुत्रस्य दुःखेन साधयिष्ये हुताशनम् ..
यावच्छोकाग्निना कायो दह्यते न वरान ने .. 47 ..
5.21.m: Because of sorrow for my son, I will enter the fire / before my body is burned up by the fire of grief, O fair-faced lady!" // 47

5.21.s:
.. brāhmaṇyuvāca .. ..
mamāpi matametaddhi yattvayā parikīrtitam ..
tatkiṃ cirayasi brahmañchīghraṃ dārūṇi cānaya .. 48 ..
5.21.d:
.. ब्राह्मण्युवाच .. ..
ममापि मतमेतद्धि यत्त्वया परिकीर्तितम् ..
तत्किं चिरयसि ब्रह्मञ्छीघ्रं दारूणि चानय .. 48 ..
5.21.m: The brahmin lady said: / "Indeed, my mind is also set upon what you have declared. / Why then do you delay, O brahmin? Bring firewood quickly, // 48

5.21.s:
yenā'haṃ bhavatā sārdhaṃ pravekṣyāmi hutāśanam ..
putraśokena saṃtaptā subhṛśaṃ duḥkhaśāṃtaye .. 49 ..
5.21.d:
येनाऽहं भवता सार्धं प्रवेक्ष्यामि हुताशनम् ..
पुत्रशोकेन संतप्ता सुभृशं दुःखशांतये .. 49 ..
5.21.m: so that, along with you, I may enter the fire, / exceedingly consumed with grief for my son, for the appeasement of sorrow." // 49

5.21.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
evaṃ tayoḥ pravadatordaṃpatyordvija sattamāḥ ..
ājagāmā'tha saṃhṛṣṭaḥ sa bālaḥ sannidhiṃ tayoḥ .. 6.21.50 ..
5.21.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
एवं तयोः प्रवदतोर्दंपत्योर्द्विज सत्तमाः ..
आजगामाऽथ संहृष्टः स बालः सन्निधिं तयोः .. 6.21.50 ..
5.21.m: Sūta said: / As the couple was speaking thus, O best of the twice-born, / that joyful boy came into their presence. // 50

5.21.s:
taṃ dṛṣṭvā brāhmaṇo hṛṣṭo brāhmaṇyā sahitastadā ..
ānaṃdāśruplutākṣo'tha sammukha stamupādravat .. 51 ..
5.21.d:
तं दृष्ट्वा ब्राह्मणो हृष्टो ब्राह्मण्या सहितस्तदा ..
आनंदाश्रुप्लुताक्षोऽथ सम्मुख स्तमुपाद्रवत् .. 51 ..
5.21.m: Seeing him, the brahmin, delighted along with the brahmin lady, / ran forward toward him, his eyes flooded with tears of joy. // 51

5.21.s:
bhūyobhūyaḥ pariṣvajya sabhāryaḥ pṛṣṭavāṃstadā ..
kva gataḥ svāśramādvatsa cirātkasmādihā''gataḥ.. 52 ..
5.21.d:
भूयोभूयः परिष्वज्य सभार्यः पृष्टवांस्तदा ..
क्व गतः स्वाश्रमाद्वत्स चिरात्कस्मादिहा'ऽगतः.. 52 ..
5.21.m: Embracing him again and again along with his wife, he then asked: / "Where did you go from your own hermitage, child? Why have you come here after so long?" // 52

5.21.s:
śokārṇave parikṣipya māṃ sabhāryaṃ vayo'dhikam ..
tanmā putraka bhūyastvamīdṛkkarma kariṣyasi .. 53 ..
5.21.d:
शोकार्णवे परिक्षिप्य मां सभार्यं वयोऽधिकम् ..
तन्मा पुत्रक भूयस्त्वमीदृक्कर्म करिष्यसि .. 53 ..
5.21.m: having cast me together with my wife, advanced in years, into an ocean of grief. / Therefore, dear son, do not ever do such a thing again."

5.21.s:
.. mārkaṃḍeya uvāca .. ..
atrā'dya munayaḥ prāptā mayā te cābhivāditāḥ ..
krameṇa vinayāttāta smaramāṇena te vacaḥ .. 54
5.21.d:
.. मार्कंडेय उवाच .. ..
अत्राऽद्य मुनयः प्राप्ता मया ते चाभिवादिताः ..
क्रमेण विनयात्तात स्मरमाणेन ते वचः .. 54
5.21.m: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / "Sages arrived here today, and they were greeted by me / in proper order with humility, father, remembering your instruction.

5.21.s:
dīrghāyurbhava tairuktaḥ sarvaireva dvijottamaiḥ ..
dṛṣṭvā māṃ vismayāviṣṭairbālakaṃ vratinaṃ vibho .. 55 ..
5.21.d:
दीर्घायुर्भव तैरुक्तः सर्वैरेव द्विजोत्तमैः ..
दृष्ट्वा मां विस्मयाविष्टैर्बालकं व्रतिनं विभो .. 55 ..
5.21.m: I was told by all those best of twice-born: 'May you be long-lived!' / having seen me, a boy observing vows, O lord, filled with astonishment.

5.21.s:
atha tāta samālokya teṣāṃ madhyagato muniḥ ..
vasiṣṭhastānmunīnsarvānprovāca prahasanniva .. 56 ..
5.21.d:
अथ तात समालोक्य तेषां मध्यगतो मुनिः ..
वसिष्ठस्तान्मुनीन्सर्वान्प्रोवाच प्रहसन्निव .. 56 ..
5.21.m: Then, having looked [at me], father, the sage situated among them, / Vasiṣṭha, spoke to all those sages as if smiling:

5.21.s:
.. vasiṣṭha uvāca .. ..
dīrghāyurbhava yaḥ prokto yuṣmābhirmunipuṃgavāḥ ..
tṛtīye divase so'yaṃ bālaḥ paṃcatvameṣyati .. 57 ..
5.21.d:
.. वसिष्ठ उवाच .. ..
दीर्घायुर्भव यः प्रोक्तो युष्माभिर्मुनिपुंगवाः ..
तृतीये दिवसे सोऽयं बालः पंचत्वमेष्यति .. 57 ..
5.21.m: Vasiṣṭha said: / 'He to whom it was said by you, O bulls among sages, "May you be long-lived!"— / this very boy will meet his death on the third day.'

5.21.s:
tataste munayo bhītā asatyāttāta tatkṣaṇāt ..
samādāya yayustatra yatra brahmā vyavasthitaḥ .. 58 ..
5.21.d:
ततस्ते मुनयो भीता असत्यात्तात तत्क्षणात् ..
समादाय ययुस्तत्र यत्र ब्रह्मा व्यवस्थितः .. 58 ..
5.21.m: Then those sages, afraid of falsehood, father, immediately / took [me] and went there where Brahmā was residing.

5.21.s:
namaskṛtena tenā'pi prokto'haṃ padmayoninā ..
dīrghāyurbhava pṛṣṭaśca kutastvamiha cāgataḥ 59 ..
5.21.d:
नमस्कृतेन तेनाऽपि प्रोक्तोऽहं पद्मयोनिना ..
दीर्घायुर्भव पृष्टश्च कुतस्त्वमिह चागतः 59 ..
5.21.m: Having been paid homage, I was also told by that lotus-born [Brahmā]: / 'May you be long-lived!' and I was asked: 'From where have you come here?'

5.21.s:
atha tairmunibhiḥ sarvairvṛttāṃtaṃ tasya kīrtitam..
āśīrvādodbhavaṃ proktaṃ tato vayamihāgatāḥ.. 6.21.60 ..
5.21.d:
अथ तैर्मुनिभिः सर्वैर्वृत्तांतं तस्य कीर्तितम्..
आशीर्वादोद्भवं प्रोक्तं ततो वयमिहागताः.. 6.21.60 ..
5.21.m: Then the entire account was related to him by all those sages: / 'This arose from our blessing, and therefore we have come here.

5.21.s:
yathā'yaṃ bālako deva tvatprasādātpitāmaha ..
dīrghāyurjāyate loke tathā tvaṃ kartumarhasi .. 61 ..
5.21.d:
यथाऽयं बालको देव त्वत्प्रसादात्पितामह ..
दीर्घायुर्जायते लोके तथा त्वं कर्तुमर्हसि .. 61 ..
5.21.m: In such a way that this boy, O god, through your grace, O grandfather, / may become long-lived in the world, so you ought to act.'

5.21.s:
tato'haṃ brahmaṇā tāta jarāmaraṇavarjitaḥ ..
vihitaḥ preṣitastūrṇaṃ svagṛhaṃ prati taiḥ samam .. 62 ..
5.21.d:
ततोऽहं ब्रह्मणा तात जरामरणवर्जितः ..
विहितः प्रेषितस्तूर्णं स्वगृहं प्रति तैः समम् .. 62 ..
5.21.m: Then, father, I was made free from old age and death by Brahmā, / and was sent swiftly back towards my own home together with them.

5.21.s:
te tu māṃ munayotraiva pramucyāśramasannidhau ..
snānārthaṃ viviśuḥ sarve hrade'traiva suśobhane .. 63 ..
5.21.d:
ते तु मां मुनयोत्रैव प्रमुच्याश्रमसन्निधौ ..
स्नानार्थं विविशुः सर्वे ह्रदेऽत्रैव सुशोभने .. 63 ..
5.21.m: Those sages, however, having released me right here near the hermitage, / all entered this very beautiful pool for ritual ablution."

5.21.s:
tacchrutvā vacanaṃ tasya mṛkaṃḍo harṣasaṃyutaḥ ..
prayayau satvaraṃ tatra yatra te munayaḥ sthitāḥ .. 64 ..
5.21.d:
तच्छ्रुत्वा वचनं तस्य मृकंडो हर्षसंयुतः ..
प्रययौ सत्वरं तत्र यत्र ते मुनयः स्थिताः .. 64 ..
5.21.m: Having heard his speech, Mṛkaṇḍa, filled with joy, / went swiftly there where those sages were staying.

5.21.s:
praṇamya tānmunīnsarvānkṛtāñjalipuṭaḥ sthitaḥ ..
provāca vaḥ prasādena kulaṃ me vṛddhimāgatam .. 65 ..
5.21.d:
प्रणम्य तान्मुनीन्सर्वान्कृताञ्जलिपुटः स्थितः ..
प्रोवाच वः प्रसादेन कुलं मे वृद्धिमागतम् .. 65 ..
5.21.m: Bowing to all those sages, standing with folded hands, / he said: "By your grace my family has reached prosperity.

5.21.s:
sādhu proktamidaṃ kaiścidācāryairmunisattamāḥ ..
sādhulokaṃ samāśritya vikhyātaṃ ca jagattraye .. 66 ..
5.21.d:
साधु प्रोक्तमिदं कैश्चिदाचार्यैर्मुनिसत्तमाः ..
साधुलोकं समाश्रित्य विख्यातं च जगत्त्रये .. 66 ..
5.21.m: This was well said by certain teachers, O best of sages, / relying on good people, and is renowned in the three worlds:

5.21.s:
sādhūnāṃ darśanaṃ puṇyaṃ tīrthabhūtā hi sādhavaḥ ..
tīrthaṃ phalati kālena sadyaḥ sādhusamāgamaḥ .. 67 ..
5.21.d:
साधूनां दर्शनं पुण्यं तीर्थभूता हि साधवः ..
तीर्थं फलति कालेन सद्यः साधुसमागमः .. 67 ..
5.21.m: 'The sight of good people is holy, for good people are indeed sacred fords; / a sacred ford bears fruit in time, [but] association with good people [bears fruit] immediately.'

5.21.s:
tasmādatithayaḥ prāptā yūyaṃ sarve'dya me gṛham ..
prakaromi kimātithyaṃ procyatāṃ dvijasattamāḥ .. 68 ..
5.21.d:
तस्मादतिथयः प्राप्ता यूयं सर्वेऽद्य मे गृहम् ..
प्रकरोमि किमातिथ्यं प्रोच्यतां द्विजसत्तमाः .. 68 ..
5.21.m: Therefore, having arrived today at my home as guests, / what hospitality may I offer you? Let it be spoken, O best of twice-born!"

5.21.s:
.. ṛṣaya ūcuḥ .. ..
etadeva mune'smākamātithyaṃ koṭisaṃmitam ..
alpāyurapi te bālo yajjāto mṛtyuvarjitaḥ .. 69 ..
5.21.d:
.. ऋषय ऊचुः .. ..
एतदेव मुनेऽस्माकमातिथ्यं कोटिसंमितम् ..
अल्पायुरपि ते बालो यज्जातो मृत्युवर्जितः .. 69 ..
5.21.m: The seers said: / "This alone is hospitality worth ten million to us, O sage: / that your boy, though short-lived, has become free from death."

5.21.s:
.. mṛkaṇḍa uvāca .. ..
mṛtyunā''liṃgitaṃ bālamasmadīyaṃ munīśvarāḥ ..
bhavadbhiradya saṃrakṣya kulaṃ kṛtsnaṃ samuddhṛtam .. 6.21.70 ..
5.21.d:
.. मृकण्ड उवाच .. ..
मृत्युना'ऽलिंगितं बालमस्मदीयं मुनीश्वराः ..
भवद्भिरद्य संरक्ष्य कुलं कृत्स्नं समुद्धृतम् .. 6.21.70 ..
5.21.m: Mṛkaṇḍa said: / "Our boy was embraced by death, O lords of sages; / having protected [him] today, the entire lineage has been redeemed by you.

5.21.s:
brahmaghne ca surāpe ca caure bhagnavrate tathā ..
niṣkṛtirvihitā sadbhiḥ kṛtaghne nā'sti niṣkṛtiḥ .. 71 ...
5.21.d:
ब्रह्मघ्ने च सुरापे च चौरे भग्नव्रते तथा ..
निष्कृतिर्विहिता सद्भिः कृतघ्ने नाऽस्ति निष्कृतिः .. 71 ...
5.21.m: For a killer of a brahmin, a drinker of liquor, a thief, and likewise one who has broken his vow, / expiation has been prescribed by the good; for an ungrateful person, there is no expiation.

5.21.s:
tasmātkṛtaghnatādoṣo na syānmama munīśvarāḥ ..
yathā kāryaṃ bhavadbhiśca tathā sarvairna saṃśayaḥ .. 72 ..
5.21.d:
तस्मात्कृतघ्नतादोषो न स्यान्मम मुनीश्वराः ..
यथा कार्यं भवद्भिश्च तथा सर्वैर्न संशयः .. 72 ..
5.21.m: Therefore, O lords of sages, so that the fault of ingratitude might not fall on me, / something must without doubt be done by you all."

5.21.s:
.. ṛṣaya ūcuḥ .. ..
yadi pratyupakārāya manyase tvaṃ dvijottama ..
gṛhaṃ kuruṣva no vākyāddevasya parameṣṭhinaḥ .. 73 ..
5.21.d:
.. ऋषय ऊचुः .. ..
यदि प्रत्युपकाराय मन्यसे त्वं द्विजोत्तम ..
गृहं कुरुष्व नो वाक्याद्देवस्य परमेष्ठिनः .. 73 ..
5.21.m: The seers said: / "If you consider [making] a return favor, O best of twice-born, / make a temple for the god, the Supreme Lord [Brahmā], according to our word,

5.21.s:
yenā'yaṃ bālakaste'dya kṛto mṛtyuvivarjitaḥ ..
tasmātsthāpaya tīrthena devaṃ taṃ prapitāmaham..74..
5.21.d:
येनाऽयं बालकस्तेऽद्य कृतो मृत्युविवर्जितः ..
तस्मात्स्थापय तीर्थेन देवं तं प्रपितामहम्..74..
5.21.m: by whom this boy of yours was made free from death today. / Therefore establish that god, the great-grandfather, by the sacred ford.

5.21.s:
putreṇa sahitaḥ paścādārādhaya divāniśam..
vayameva tvayā sārdhaṃ taṃ ca devaṃ pitāmaham..75..
5.21.d:
पुत्रेण सहितः पश्चादाराधय दिवानिशम्..
वयमेव त्वया सार्धं तं च देवं पितामहम्..75..
5.21.m: Together with your son, worship [him] afterwards day and night. / We ourselves, along with you, [shall worship] that god, the grandfather;

5.21.s:
nityaṃ prapūjayiṣyāmastathānye'pi dvijottamāḥ..
bālenā'nena sārdhaṃ te sakhyamatra sthitaṃ yataḥ..
bālasakhyamiti khyātaṃ nāmnā tena bhaviṣyati..76..
5.21.d:
नित्यं प्रपूजयिष्यामस्तथान्येऽपि द्विजोत्तमाः..
बालेनाऽनेन सार्धं ते सख्यमत्र स्थितं यतः..
बालसख्यमिति ख्यातं नाम्ना तेन भविष्यति..76..
5.21.m: we and other best of twice-born shall worship him constantly. / Since your friendship with this boy was established here, / therefore it will be celebrated by the name Bālasakhya.

5.21.s:
tīrthamanyairiti khyātaṃ bālakānāṃ hitāvaham..
rogārtānāṃ bhayārtānāmasmākaṃ vacanātsadā..77..
5.21.d:
तीर्थमन्यैरिति ख्यातं बालकानां हितावहम्..
रोगार्तानां भयार्तानामस्माकं वचनात्सदा..77..
5.21.m: The sacred ford is known by others as bringing welfare to children, / to those afflicted with disease and those afflicted with fear, always through our word.

5.21.s:
asmiṃstīrthe śiśuṃ lokāḥ snāpayiṣyaṃti ye dvija..
rogārtaṃ vā bhayārtaṃ vā pīḍitaṃ vā grahādibhiḥ..78..
5.21.d:
अस्मिंस्तीर्थे शिशुं लोकाः स्नापयिष्यंति ये द्विज..
रोगार्तं वा भयार्तं वा पीडितं वा ग्रहादिभिः..78..
5.21.m: Whatever people bathe a child in this sacred ford, O twice-born, / whether afflicted with disease, afflicted with fear, or tormented by planetary spirits and the like,

5.21.s:
bhaviṣyati na saṃdehaḥ sarvadoṣavivarjitaḥ ..
pitāmahaprasādena tathā'smadvacanāddvija .. 79 ..
5.21.d:
भविष्यति न संदेहः सर्वदोषविवर्जितः ..
पितामहप्रसादेन तथाऽस्मद्वचनाद्द्विज .. 79 ..
5.21.m: he will become freed from all defects, there is no doubt, / through the grace of the grandfather and through our word, O twice-born.

5.21.s:
ye punarmānuṣā vipra niṣkāmāḥ śraddhayānvitāḥ ..
snānamātraṃ kariṣyaṃti te yāṃti paramāṃ gatim.. 6.21.80 ..
5.21.d:
ये पुनर्मानुषा विप्र निष्कामाः श्रद्धयान्विताः ..
स्नानमात्रं करिष्यंति ते यांति परमां गतिम्.. 6.21.80 ..
5.21.m: Moreover, those human beings, O vipra, who, free from desires and endowed with faith, / perform merely a ritual ablution, go to the supreme state."

5.21.s:
evamuktvātha te sarve munayaḥ śaṃsitavratāḥ ..
tamāmaṃtrya muniṃ jagmustīrthānyanyāni satvarāḥ .. 81 ..
5.21.d:
एवमुक्त्वाथ ते सर्वे मुनयः शंसितव्रताः ..
तमामंत्र्य मुनिं जग्मुस्तीर्थान्यन्यानि सत्वराः .. 81 ..
5.21.m: Having spoken thus, all those sages of praiseworthy vows, / taking leave of that sage, went swiftly to other sacred fords.

5.21.s:
mṛkaṇḍo'pi saputraśca tasminsthāne pitāmaham ..
sthāpayāmāsa saṃhṛṣṭo jyeṣṭhe jyeṣṭhāsthite vidhau .. 82 ..
5.21.d:
मृकण्डोऽपि सपुत्रश्च तस्मिन्स्थाने पितामहम् ..
स्थापयामास संहृष्टो ज्येष्ठे ज्येष्ठास्थिते विधौ .. 82 ..
5.21.m: Mṛkaṇḍa too, along with his son, established the grandfather in that place, / delighted, in the month of Jyeṣṭha when the moon was in Jyeṣṭhā.

5.21.s:
tataścā''rādhayāmāsa divārātramataṃdritaḥ ..
saputraḥ śraddhayā yuktaḥ saṃprāptaśca parāṃ gatim .. 83 ..
5.21.d:
ततश्चा'ऽराधयामास दिवारात्रमतंद्रितः ..
सपुत्रः श्रद्धया युक्तः संप्राप्तश्च परां गतिम् .. 83 ..
5.21.m: Then, unwearied, endowed with faith, together with his son, / he worshipped day and night, and reached the supreme state.

5.21.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
tataḥprabhṛti tattīrthaṃ bālasakhyamiti smṛtam..
pāvanaṃ sarvajaṃtūnāṃ bālānāṃ roganāśanam.. 84 ..
5.21.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
ततःप्रभृति तत्तीर्थं बालसख्यमिति स्मृतम्..
पावनं सर्वजंतूनां बालानां रोगनाशनम्.. 84 ..
5.21.m: Sūta said: / From that time on, that sacred ford has been known as Bālasakhya, / purifying all creatures and destroying diseases of children.

5.21.s:
jyeṣṭhe jyeṣṭhāsu yo bālastatra snānaṃ samācaret ..
na sa pīḍāmavāpnoti yāvatsaṃvatsaraṃ dvijāḥ .. 85 ..
5.21.d:
ज्येष्ठे ज्येष्ठासु यो बालस्तत्र स्नानं समाचरेत् ..
न स पीडामवाप्नोति यावत्संवत्सरं द्विजाः .. 85 ..
5.21.m: Whatever child performs ritual ablution there in Jyeṣṭha during Jyeṣṭhā, / he does not suffer affliction for a whole year, O twice-born.

5.21.s:
grahabhūtapiśācānāṃ śākinīnāṃ viśeṣataḥ ..
agamyaḥ sarvaduṣṭānāṃ tathā'nyeṣāṃ prajāyate ..86..
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye bālasakhyatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmaikaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ.. .. 21 .. .. dha ..
5.21.d:
ग्रहभूतपिशाचानां शाकिनीनां विशेषतः ..
अगम्यः सर्वदुष्टानां तथाऽन्येषां प्रजायते ..86..
इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां षष्ठे नागरखण्डे हाटकेश्वरक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये बालसख्यतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनामैकविंशोऽध्यायः.. .. 21 .. .. ध ..
5.21.m:
He becomes unassailable by planetary spirits, bhūtas, piśācas, / and especially by śākinīs and all other wicked beings.
Thus ends the twenty-first chapter, named 'Description of the Māhātmya of the Bālasakhya Tīrtha', in the section on the Māhātmya of Hāṭakeśvara Kṣetra, in the Nāgarakhaṇḍa, the sixth [book] in the eighty-one-thousand-verse collection of the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa. 21.

5.22.s:
.. ṛṣaya ūcuḥ .. ..
yadetadbhavatā proktaṃ tīrthe śakrasamudravam..
svāmidrohakṛtātpāpānnirmukto yatra lakṣmaṇaḥ .. 1 ..
5.22.d:
.. ऋषय ऊचुः .. ..
यदेतद्भवता प्रोक्तं तीर्थे शक्रसमुद्रवम्..
स्वामिद्रोहकृतात्पापान्निर्मुक्तो यत्र लक्ष्मणः .. 1 ..
5.22.m: The seers said: / "As for that which was mentioned by you regarding the sacred ford arisen from Indra, / where Lakṣmaṇa was freed from the sin born of treachery to one's master—

5.22.s:
kathaṃ tatra purā śakraḥ svāmidrohasamudbhavāt ..
pātakādeva nirmuktaḥ kasminkāle ca sūtaja..2..
5.22.d:
कथं तत्र पुरा शक्रः स्वामिद्रोहसमुद्भवात् ..
पातकादेव निर्मुक्तः कस्मिन्काले च सूतज..2..
5.22.m: how was Indra formerly freed from the very sin born of treachery to his master / at that place, and at what time, O son of Sūta?

5.22.s:
kasmādditermahendreṇa kṛtaṃ kṛtyaṃ tathāvidham ..
yena saṃsūdito garbhaḥ sarvaṃ vistarato vada ..3..
5.22.d:
कस्माद्दितेर्महेन्द्रेण कृतं कृत्यं तथाविधम् ..
येन संसूदितो गर्भः सर्वं विस्तरतो वद ..3..
5.22.m: Why was such an act committed against Diti by Mahendra, / by which her fetus was destroyed? Tell everything in detail."

5.22.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
brahmaṇo dakṣiṇāṃguṣṭhājjajñe dakṣaḥ prajāpatiḥ ..
sa ca saṃjanayāmāsa pacāśatkanyakāḥ śubhāḥ ..4..
5.22.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
ब्रह्मणो दक्षिणांगुष्ठाज्जज्ञे दक्षः प्रजापतिः ..
स च संजनयामास पचाशत्कन्यकाः शुभाः ..4..
5.22.m: Sūta said: / "From the right thumb of Brahmā, the lord of creatures Dakṣa was born, / and he begot fifty auspicious daughters.

5.22.s:
dadau ca daśa dharmāya kaśyapāya trayodaśa ..
divyena vidhinā dakṣaḥ saptaviṃśatimiṃdave .. 5 ..
5.22.d:
ददौ च दश धर्माय कश्यपाय त्रयोदश ..
दिव्येन विधिना दक्षः सप्तविंशतिमिंदवे .. 5 ..
5.22.m: And Dakṣa gave ten to Dharma, thirteen to Kaśyapa, / and twenty-seven to the Moon according to the celestial rite.

5.22.s:
aditiśca ditiścaiva dve bhārye mukhyatāṃ gate ..
kaśyapasya dvijaśreṣṭhāḥ prāṇebhyo'pi priye sadā .. 6 ..
5.22.d:
अदितिश्च दितिश्चैव द्वे भार्ये मुख्यतां गते ..
कश्यपस्य द्विजश्रेष्ठाः प्राणेभ्योऽपि प्रिये सदा .. 6 ..
5.22.m: Aditi and Diti became the two principal wives / of Kaśyapa, O best of twice-born, always dearer than his own breaths.

5.22.s:
tataḥ sa janayāmāsa devāñcchakrapuraḥsarān..
adityāṃ caiva daityāṃśca dityāṃ sa balavattarān ..7..
5.22.d:
ततः स जनयामास देवाञ्च्छक्रपुरःसरान्..
अदित्यां चैव दैत्यांश्च दित्यां स बलवत्तरान् ..7..
5.22.m: Then he fathered upon Aditi the gods led by Śakra, / and upon Diti the mightier daityas.

5.22.s:
teṣāṃ trailokyarājyārthaṃ mitho jajñe mahāhavaḥ ..
tatra śakreṇa te daityāḥ saṃgrāme vinipātitāḥ .. 8 ..
5.22.d:
तेषां त्रैलोक्यराज्यार्थं मिथो जज्ञे महाहवः ..
तत्र शक्रेण ते दैत्याः संग्रामे विनिपातिताः .. 8 ..
5.22.m: Between them a great battle arose for the kingdom of the three worlds; / there those daityas were struck down in battle by Śakra.

5.22.s:
tataḥ śokaparā cakre ditirvratamanuttamam ..
putrārthaṃ niyamopetā kṣetre'traiva samāhitā .. 9 ..
5.22.d:
ततः शोकपरा चक्रे दितिर्व्रतमनुत्तमम् ..
पुत्रार्थं नियमोपेता क्षेत्रेऽत्रैव समाहिता .. 9 ..
5.22.m: Then Diti, overcome with grief, undertook an unsurpassed vow; / endowed with self-restraint and concentrated in mind, she stayed in this very sacred field for the sake of a son.

5.22.s:
tato varṣasahasrāṃte tasyāstuṣṭo maheśvaraḥ ..
uvāca parituṣṭo'smi varaṃ prārthaya vāṃchitam .. 6.22.10 ..
5.22.d:
ततो वर्षसहस्रांते तस्यास्तुष्टो महेश्वरः ..
उवाच परितुष्टोऽस्मि वरं प्रार्थय वांछितम् .. 6.22.10 ..
5.22.m: Then, at the end of a thousand years, Maheśvara was pleased with her; / he said, "I am well pleased; ask for your desired boon."

5.22.s:
sā'bravīdyadi me tuṣṭastvaṃ deva śaśiśekhara ..
tatputraṃ dehi devānāṃ sarveṣāṃ balavattaram..
yajñabhāgaprabhoktāraṃ devānāṃ darpanāśanam .. 11 ..
5.22.d:
साऽब्रवीद्यदि मे तुष्टस्त्वं देव शशिशेखर ..
तत्पुत्रं देहि देवानां सर्वेषां बलवत्तरम्..
यज्ञभागप्रभोक्तारं देवानां दर्पनाशनम् .. 11 ..
5.22.m: She said: "If you are pleased with me, O god crowned with the crescent moon, / then grant me a son mightier than all the gods, / who will enjoy the sacrificial share and destroy the pride of the gods,

5.22.s:
avadhyaṃ saṃgare pūrvaiḥ sarvaidevaiḥ savāsavaiḥ ..
sa tatheti pratijñāya jagāmādarśanaṃ haraḥ .. 12 ..
5.22.d:
अवध्यं संगरे पूर्वैः सर्वैदेवैः सवासवैः ..
स तथेति प्रतिज्ञाय जगामादर्शनं हरः .. 12 ..
5.22.m: one who cannot be slain in battle by all the gods together with Vāsava." / Having pledged "So be it," Hara vanished from sight.

5.22.s:
ditiścaivā'dadhādgarbhaṃ kaśyapānmunipuṃgavāt ..
tataḥ śakro bhayaṃ cakre jñātvā taṃ garbhasaṃbhavam..
vadato munimukhyasya nāradasya mahātmanaḥ .. 13 ..
5.22.d:
दितिश्चैवाऽदधाद्गर्भं कश्यपान्मुनिपुंगवात् ..
ततः शक्रो भयं चक्रे ज्ञात्वा तं गर्भसंभवम्..
वदतो मुनिमुख्यस्य नारदस्य महात्मनः .. 13 ..
5.22.m: And Diti conceived an embryo from Kaśyapa, the foremost of sages. / Then Śakra felt fear, having learned of that conception / as the noble Nārada, the chief of sages, told of it.

5.22.s:
tato duṣṭāṃ matiṃ kṛtvā tasya garbhasya nāśane ..
cakre tasyāḥ sa śuśrūṣāṃ divārātramataṃdritaḥ .. 14 ..
5.22.d:
ततो दुष्टां मतिं कृत्वा तस्य गर्भस्य नाशने ..
चक्रे तस्याः स शुश्रूषां दिवारात्रमतंद्रितः .. 14 ..
5.22.m: Then, forming a wicked intent to destroy that embryo, / he attended upon her day and night without wearying,

5.22.s:
chidramanveṣamāṇastu susūkṣmamapi ca dvijāḥ ..
na tasyā labhate kvā'pi gatā māsā navaiva tu .. 15 ..
5.22.d:
छिद्रमन्वेषमाणस्तु सुसूक्ष्ममपि च द्विजाः ..
न तस्या लभते क्वाऽपि गता मासा नवैव तु .. 15 ..
5.22.m: seeking a flaw, even a very subtle one, O brahmins; / but he found none at all in her, and nine months passed.

5.22.s:
tataśca daśame māsi saṃprāpte prasavodbhave ..
garbhālasā niśāvaktre suptā sā dakṣiṇāmukhī .. 16 ..
5.22.d:
ततश्च दशमे मासि संप्राप्ते प्रसवोद्भवे ..
गर्भालसा निशावक्त्रे सुप्ता सा दक्षिणामुखी .. 16 ..
5.22.m: Then, when the tenth month arrived, bringing about childbirth, / she, weary from pregnancy, fell asleep at nightfall facing south.

5.22.s:
nidrāvaśaṃ tu saṃprāptā visaṃjñā samapadyata..
śakrahastāvamardotthapādasaukhyena niścalā .. 17 ..
5.22.d:
निद्रावशं तु संप्राप्ता विसंज्ञा समपद्यत..
शक्रहस्तावमर्दोत्थपादसौख्येन निश्चला .. 17 ..
5.22.m: Overcome by sleep, she became unconscious, / remaining motionless from the comfort of her feet being massaged by Śakra's hands.

5.22.s:
tāṃ visaṃjñāmatho vīkṣya tyaktvā pādau śatakratuḥ ..
praviveśodaraṃ tasyāstīkṣṇaṃ śastraṃ kare dadhat ..
tenā'sau saptadhā cake garbhaṃ śastreṇa devapaḥ .. 18 ..
5.22.d:
तां विसंज्ञामथो वीक्ष्य त्यक्त्वा पादौ शतक्रतुः ..
प्रविवेशोदरं तस्यास्तीक्ष्णं शस्त्रं करे दधत् ..
तेनाऽसौ सप्तधा चके गर्भं शस्त्रेण देवपः .. 18 ..
5.22.m: Seeing her unconscious, Śatakratu let go of her feet / and entered her womb, holding a sharp weapon in his hand. / With that weapon, the lord of gods cut the embryo into seven pieces.

5.22.s:
athā'paśyatkṣaṇātsapta vālakānpūrṇavigrahān ..
tatastānapi saptaiva saptadhā kṛtavānhariḥ .. 19 ..
5.22.d:
अथाऽपश्यत्क्षणात्सप्त वालकान्पूर्णविग्रहान् ..
ततस्तानपि सप्तैव सप्तधा कृतवान्हरिः .. 19 ..
5.22.m: Then in an instant he saw seven boys with complete bodies; / thereupon Hari cut those seven too into seven parts each.

5.22.s:
jātā ekonapañcāśadatha tatraiva bālakāḥ ..
tāndṛṣṭvā vṛddhimāpannāṃstato bhītaḥ śatakratuḥ ..
niścakrāmodarātūrṇaṃ dityā yāvanna lakṣitaḥ .. 6.22.20 ..
5.22.d:
जाता एकोनपञ्चाशदथ तत्रैव बालकाः ..
तान्दृष्ट्वा वृद्धिमापन्नांस्ततो भीतः शतक्रतुः ..
निश्चक्रामोदरातूर्णं दित्या यावन्न लक्षितः .. 6.22.20 ..
5.22.m: Thus forty-nine boys came into being right there. / Seeing them continuing to grow, Śatakratu became terrified / and quickly emerged from the womb before he could be noticed by Diti.

5.22.s:
tataḥ prabhāte vimale prodgate ravimaṃḍale ..
ditiḥ saṃjanayāmāsa saptadhā sapta bālakān.. 21 ..
5.22.d:
ततः प्रभाते विमले प्रोद्गते रविमंडले ..
दितिः संजनयामास सप्तधा सप्त बालकान्.. 21 ..
5.22.m: Then, in the spotless morning, when the sun's orb had risen, / Diti gave birth to the seven times seven boys.

5.22.s:
tato'bhyetya sahasrākṣo durgaṃdhena samāvṛtaḥ ..
nistejā mlānavaktraśca lajjayā' dhomukhaḥ sthitaḥ .. 22 ..
5.22.d:
ततोऽभ्येत्य सहस्राक्षो दुर्गंधेन समावृतः ..
निस्तेजा म्लानवक्त्रश्च लज्जया' धोमुखः स्थितः .. 22 ..
5.22.m: Then the thousand-eyed [god] approached, enveloped in a foul stench, / devoid of splendor, his face withered, standing with head bowed in shame.

5.22.s:
taṃ dṛṣṭvā tādṛśaṃ śakraṃ ditiḥ provāca sādaram ..
praṇataṃ saṃsthitaṃ pārśve bhayavyākulacetasam .. 23 ..
5.22.d:
तं दृष्ट्वा तादृशं शक्रं दितिः प्रोवाच सादरम् ..
प्रणतं संस्थितं पार्श्वे भयव्याकुलचेतसम् .. 23 ..
5.22.m: Seeing Śakra in such a state, bowed down, / standing at her side with his mind agitated by fear, Diti spoke with respect:

5.22.s:
kiṃ tvaṃ śakra niru tsāhastejodyutivivarjitaḥ ..
śarīrāttava durgandhaḥ kasmādīdṛkprajāyate .. 24 ..
5.22.d:
किं त्वं शक्र निरु त्साहस्तेजोद्युतिविवर्जितः ..
शरीरात्तव दुर्गन्धः कस्मादीदृक्प्रजायते .. 24 ..
5.22.m: "Why are you dispirited, O Śakra, bereft of luster and brilliance? / Why does such a foul odor arise from your body?

5.22.s:
kiṃ tvayā nihato viprogururvābālako'thavā ..
nārī vā yena te naṣṭaṃ tejo gātrasamudbhavam .. 25 ..
5.22.d:
किं त्वया निहतो विप्रोगुरुर्वाबालकोऽथवा ..
नारी वा येन ते नष्टं तेजो गात्रसमुद्भवम् .. 25 ..
5.22.m: Did you kill a brahmin, or a guru, or a child, / or a woman, on account of which the splendor born of your body is lost?

5.22.s:
hato nakhāṃbhasā vā tvaṃ ghṛṣṭaḥ śūrpānilena ca ..
ajāmārjanikotthaiścarajobhirvā samāśritaḥ .. 26 ..
5.22.d:
हतो नखांभसा वा त्वं घृष्टः शूर्पानिलेन च ..
अजामार्जनिकोत्थैश्चरजोभिर्वा समाश्रितः .. 26 ..
5.22.m: Were you struck with water from fingernails, or brushed with the wind of a winnowing basket, / or covered with dust raised by a broom made of goat-hair?"

5.22.s:
.. śakra uvāca .. ..
satyametanmahābhāge yattvayokto'smi sāṃpratam ..
rātrau praviṣṭaḥ suptāyā jaṭhare tava pāpakṛt .. 27 ..
5.22.d:
.. शक्र उवाच .. ..
सत्यमेतन्महाभागे यत्त्वयोक्तोऽस्मि सांप्रतम् ..
रात्रौ प्रविष्टः सुप्ताया जठरे तव पापकृत् .. 27 ..
5.22.m: Śakra said: / "True is this, O fortunate lady, which you have just spoken to me. / At night, doing evil, I entered your belly while you slept,

5.22.s:
kṛntaścaikonapañcāśatkṛtvo garbho mayā śubhe ..
tāvanmātrāstato jātā bālakāḥ sarva eva te .. 28 ..
5.22.d:
कृन्तश्चैकोनपञ्चाशत्कृत्वो गर्भो मया शुभे ..
तावन्मात्रास्ततो जाता बालकाः सर्व एव ते .. 28 ..
5.22.m: and the embryo, O auspicious lady, was cut by me forty-nine times; / just that many boys were born from it, each and every one.

5.22.s:
tato bhītyā viniṣkrāntastvayā devi na lakṣitaḥ ..
etasmātkāraṇājjātā tejohāniranindite .. 29 ..
5.22.d:
ततो भीत्या विनिष्क्रान्तस्त्वया देवि न लक्षितः ..
एतस्मात्कारणाज्जाता तेजोहानिरनिन्दिते .. 29 ..
5.22.m: Then I emerged in fear, unnoticed by you, O goddess. / For this reason, O blameless one, has loss of luster befallen me."

5.22.s:
.. ditiruvāca .. ..
yasmātsatyaṃ tvayā proktaṃ purato mama devapa ..
tasmātprārthaya mattastvaṃ varaṃ yanmanasepsi tam .. 6.22.30 ..
5.22.d:
.. दितिरुवाच .. ..
यस्मात्सत्यं त्वया प्रोक्तं पुरतो मम देवप ..
तस्मात्प्रार्थय मत्तस्त्वं वरं यन्मनसेप्सि तम् .. 6.22.30 ..
5.22.m: Diti said: / "Since you have spoken the truth before me, O lord of gods, / therefore ask from me the boon that is desired by your mind."

5.22.s:
.. śakra uvāca .. ..
ete tava sutā devi cchidyamānā mayāsinā ..
rudanto vāritā mandaṃ mā rudantu muhurmuhuḥ .. 31 ..
5.22.d:
.. शक्र उवाच .. ..
एते तव सुता देवि च्छिद्यमाना मयासिना ..
रुदन्तो वारिता मन्दं मा रुदन्तु मुहुर्मुहुः .. 31 ..
5.22.m: Śakra said: / "These sons of yours, O goddess, as they were being cut by me with a sword, / wept, and were restrained by me softly: 'Do not weep [mā rudanta]!' again and again.

5.22.s:
maruto nāmavikhyātāstasmātsaṃtujagatraye ..
daityabhāvavinirmuktā madvidheyā mama priyāḥ .. 32 ..
5.22.d:
मरुतो नामविख्यातास्तस्मात्संतुजगत्रये ..
दैत्यभावविनिर्मुक्ता मद्विधेया मम प्रियाः .. 32 ..
5.22.m: Therefore let them be renowned as the Maruts in the three worlds; / freed from daitya nature, obedient to me, and dear to me,

5.22.s:
yajñabhāgabhujaḥ sarve bhaviṣyaṃti mayā saha ..
yasmādetanmayā tīrthaṃ bālakaistava maṃḍitam .. 33 ..
5.22.d:
यज्ञभागभुजः सर्वे भविष्यंति मया सह ..
यस्मादेतन्मया तीर्थं बालकैस्तव मंडितम् .. 33 ..
5.22.m: they shall all enjoy shares of the sacrifice along with me. / Because this sacred ford was adorned by me with your boys,

5.22.s:
bahubhiryāsyati khyātiṃ bālamaṃḍanamityataḥ ..
yā ca strī garbhasaṃyuktā snānaṃ bhaktyā kariṣyīta ..
na bhaviṣyaṃti chidrāṇi tasyā garbhe kathaṃcana .. 34 ..
5.22.d:
बहुभिर्यास्यति ख्यातिं बालमंडनमित्यतः ..
या च स्त्री गर्भसंयुक्ता स्नानं भक्त्या करिष्यीत ..
न भविष्यंति छिद्राणि तस्या गर्भे कथंचन .. 34 ..
5.22.m: it shall hence attain renown among many as Bālamaṇḍana. / And whichever pregnant woman performs ritual ablution [here] with devotion, / no afflictions will befall her embryo in any way.

5.22.s:
prāpte prasavakāle tu yā jalaṃ prāśayiṣyati ..
tīrthasyāsya sukhenaiva prasaviṣyati sā sutam .. 35 .. ..
5.22.d:
प्राप्ते प्रसवकाले तु या जलं प्राशयिष्यति ..
तीर्थस्यास्य सुखेनैव प्रसविष्यति सा सुतम् .. 35 .. ..
5.22.m: And when the time of delivery arrives, she who drinks water / from this sacred ford will easily give birth to a son."

5.22.s:
.. ditiruvāca .. ..
tavocchedāya deveśa yācitaḥ prāṅmayā haraḥ ..
ekaṃ deva sutaṃ dehi sarvadevanibarhaṇam .. 36 ..
5.22.d:
.. दितिरुवाच .. ..
तवोच्छेदाय देवेश याचितः प्राङ्मया हरः ..
एकं देव सुतं देहि सर्वदेवनिबर्हणम् .. 36 ..
5.22.m: Diti said: / "For your destruction, O lord of gods, Hara was formerly implored by me: / 'O god, give me a single son who will destroy all the gods!'

5.22.s:
tvayā caikonapaṃcāśatprakāraḥ sa vinirmitaḥ ..
yasmādṛtaṃ tvayā proktaṃ tasmādetadbhaviṣyati .. 37 ..
5.22.d:
त्वया चैकोनपंचाशत्प्रकारः स विनिर्मितः ..
यस्मादृतं त्वया प्रोक्तं तस्मादेतद्भविष्यति .. 37 ..
5.22.m: And you have transformed him into forty-nine forms. / Since you have spoken the truth, so shall this come to pass."

5.22.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
tataḥ prabhṛti te jātā maruto vibudhaiḥ samam ..
yajñabhāgasya bhoktāro diteḥ śakrasya śāsanāt .. 38..
5.22.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
ततः प्रभृति ते जाता मरुतो विबुधैः समम् ..
यज्ञभागस्य भोक्तारो दितेः शक्रस्य शासनात् .. 38..
5.22.m: Sūta said: / From then on, they became the Maruts, equal to the gods, / eaters of the sacrificial share, by the command of Diti and Śakra.

5.22.s:
atha prāha sahasrākṣo devācāryaṃ bṛhaspatim ..
māturdrohakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ kathaṃ yāsyati saṃkṣa yam.. 39 ..
.. bṛhaspatiruvāca .. ..
atraiva kuru devendra tapaḥ pāpaviśuddhaye ..
tīrthe yatra kṛtaṃ pāpaṃ sarvapātakanāśane ..6.22.4...
na yajñairna ca dānena nānyaistīrthasamāśrayaiḥ ..
māturdrohakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ nāśaṃ yāti puraṃdara ..
evametatparityajya tīrthaṃ mātustavā''śrayam ..4...
5.22.d:
अथ प्राह सहस्राक्षो देवाचार्यं बृहस्पतिम् ..
मातुर्द्रोहकृतं पापं कथं यास्यति संक्ष यम्.. 39 ..
.. बृहस्पतिरुवाच .. ..
अत्रैव कुरु देवेन्द्र तपः पापविशुद्धये ..
तीर्थे यत्र कृतं पापं सर्वपातकनाशने ..6.22.4...
न यज्ञैर्न च दानेन नान्यैस्तीर्थसमाश्रयैः ..
मातुर्द्रोहकृतं पापं नाशं याति पुरंदर ..
एवमेतत्परित्यज्य तीर्थं मातुस्तवा'ऽश्रयम् ..4...
5.22.m:
Then the thousand-eyed [Indra] said to Bṛhaspati, the teacher of the gods: / "How will the sin committed by treachery against a mother come to an end?"
Bṛhaspati said: / "Perform austerity right here, O lord of gods, for purification from sin, / at this sacred ford which destroys all sins, where the sin was committed.
Not by sacrifices, nor by charity, nor by resorting to other sacred fords / does sin committed through treachery against a mother perish, O Puraṃdara, / if you abandon this sacred ford, the refuge of your mother."

5.22.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
tatastūrṇaṃ saha sākṣaḥ sahasrākṣeśasaṃjñitam ..
liṃgaṃ saṃsthāpayāmāsa svayameva dvijottamāḥ .. 42 ..
5.22.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
ततस्तूर्णं सह साक्षः सहस्राक्षेशसंज्ञितम् ..
लिंगं संस्थापयामास स्वयमेव द्विजोत्तमाः .. 42 ..
5.22.m: Sūta said: / Then the thousand-eyed [god] quickly established himself, / O best of brahmins, a liṅga named Sahasrākṣeśa.

5.22.s:
trikālaṃ pūjayāmāsapuṣpadhūpānulepanaiḥ ..
tathānyairbalisatkā rairgītairnṛtyaiḥpṛthagvidhaiḥ .. 43 ..
5.22.d:
त्रिकालं पूजयामासपुष्पधूपानुलेपनैः ..
तथान्यैर्बलिसत्का रैर्गीतैर्नृत्यैःपृथग्विधैः .. 43 ..
5.22.m: He worshiped it at the three junctures of the day with flowers, incense, and ointments, / as well as other offering-honors, and various songs and dances.

5.22.s:
tato varṣasahasrāṃte tuṣṭastasya maheśvaraḥ ..
provāca varado'smīti śakra prārthaya vāṃchitam .. 44 ..
5.22.d:
ततो वर्षसहस्रांते तुष्टस्तस्य महेश्वरः ..
प्रोवाच वरदोऽस्मीति शक्र प्रार्थय वांछितम् .. 44 ..
5.22.m: Then, at the end of a thousand years, Maheśvara was pleased with him / and said: "I am a granter of boons; O Śakra, ask for your desire."

5.22.s:
.. śakra uvāca .. ...
māturdrohakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ yātu me tripurāṃtaka ..
tathā'nyeṣāṃ manuṣyāṇāṃ ye'tra tvāṃ śraddhayānvitāḥ ..
pūjayiṣyaṃti sadbhaktyā snānaṃ kṛtvā samāhitāḥ .. 45 .. ..
5.22.d:
.. शक्र उवाच .. ...
मातुर्द्रोहकृतं पापं यातु मे त्रिपुरांतक ..
तथाऽन्येषां मनुष्याणां येऽत्र त्वां श्रद्धयान्विताः ..
पूजयिष्यंति सद्भक्त्या स्नानं कृत्वा समाहिताः .. 45 .. ..
5.22.m: Śakra said: / "May the sin committed by me through treachery against a mother pass away, O destroyer of Tripura, / and likewise for other mortals who, endowed with faith, / worship you here with true devotion and concentrated minds after performing ritual ablution!"

5.22.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
sa tatheti pratijñāya jagāmādarśanaṃ haraḥ ..
śakro'pi rahitaḥ pāpairjagāma tridaśālayam .. 46 ..
5.22.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
स तथेति प्रतिज्ञाय जगामादर्शनं हरः ..
शक्रोऽपि रहितः पापैर्जगाम त्रिदशालयम् .. 46 ..
5.22.m: Sūta said: / Having promised, “So be it,” Hara vanished from sight; / and Śakra, freed from sins, went to the abode of the thirty [gods].

5.22.s:
evaṃ tatra samutpannaṃ tīrthaṃ tadbālamaṃḍanam ...
svāmidrohakṛtātpāpānmucyaṃte yatra mānavāḥ .. 47 ..
5.22.d:
एवं तत्र समुत्पन्नं तीर्थं तद्बालमंडनम् ...
स्वामिद्रोहकृतात्पापान्मुच्यंते यत्र मानवाः .. 47 ..
5.22.m: Thus arose there that sacred ford, Bālamaṇḍana, / where men are freed from the sin of being treacherous to a master.

5.22.s:
etadvaḥ sarvamākhyātaṃ bālamaṃḍanasaṃbhavam ..
māhātmyaṃ tu dvija śreṣṭhāḥ śṛṇudhvamatha sādaram .. 48 ..
5.22.d:
एतद्वः सर्वमाख्यातं बालमंडनसंभवम् ..
माहात्म्यं तु द्विज श्रेष्ठाः शृणुध्वमथ सादरम् .. 48 ..
5.22.m: All this about the origin of Bālamaṇḍana has been told to you. / Now listen with reverence, best of brahmins, to its māhātmya:

5.22.s:
āśvinasya site pakṣe daśamyādi yathākramam ..
yastatra kurute śrāddhaṃ yāvatpaṃcadaśī tithiḥ .. 49 ..
5.22.d:
आश्विनस्य सिते पक्षे दशम्यादि यथाक्रमम् ..
यस्तत्र कुरुते श्राद्धं यावत्पंचदशी तिथिः .. 49 ..
5.22.m: He who properly performs a śrāddha there during the bright fortnight of Āśvina, / beginning on the tenth day up to the fifteenth lunar day,

5.22.s:
tīrthānāṃ sa hi sarveṣāṃ snānajaṃ labhate phalam ..
śrāddhasya karaṇādvāpi vājimedhaphalaṃ dvijāḥ .. 6.22.50 ..
5.22.d:
तीर्थानां स हि सर्वेषां स्नानजं लभते फलम् ..
श्राद्धस्य करणाद्वापि वाजिमेधफलं द्विजाः .. 6.22.50 ..
5.22.m: obtains the fruit born of ritual ablution in all the sacred fords, / or indeed, O brahmins, through performing the śrāddha, the fruit of a horse-sacrifice.

5.22.s:
tasminkāle sahasrākṣaḥ samāgacchati bhūtale ..
bhāgānāṃ martyajātānāṃ sevanāya sadaiva hi .. 51 ..
5.22.d:
तस्मिन्काले सहस्राक्षः समागच्छति भूतले ..
भागानां मर्त्यजातानां सेवनाय सदैव हि .. 51 ..
5.22.m: At that time the thousand-eyed [Indra] arrives on the surface of the earth, / always to enjoy the portions offered by mortal beings.

5.22.s:
yāvadbhūmitale śakrastiṣṭhatyevaṃ dvijottamāḥ ..
tīrthe tīrthāni sarvāṇi tāvattiṣṭhanti tatra vai..52...
5.22.d:
यावद्भूमितले शक्रस्तिष्ठत्येवं द्विजोत्तमाः ..
तीर्थे तीर्थानि सर्वाणि तावत्तिष्ठन्ति तत्र वै..52...
5.22.m: As long as Śakra remains thus on the earth's surface, O best of brahmins, / so long indeed do all the sacred fords abide in that sacred ford.

5.22.s:
tasmātsarvaprayatnena tasminkāle viśeṣataḥ ..
snātvā tatra śubhe tīrthai śakreśvaramathā'rcayet .. 53 ..
5.22.d:
तस्मात्सर्वप्रयत्नेन तस्मिन्काले विशेषतः ..
स्नात्वा तत्र शुभे तीर्थै शक्रेश्वरमथाऽर्चयेत् .. 53 ..
5.22.m: Therefore, with every effort, particularly at that time, / having performed ritual ablution in that auspicious sacred ford, one should then worship Śakreśvara.

5.22.s:
atra ślokau purā gītau nāradaina sura ṣiṃṇā..
śṛṇvaṃtu munayaḥ sarve kīrtyamānau mayā hi tau .. 54 ..
5.22.d:
अत्र श्लोकौ पुरा गीतौ नारदैन सुर षिंणा..
शृण्वंतु मुनयः सर्वे कीर्त्यमानौ मया हि तौ .. 54 ..
5.22.m: Here two verses were sung of old by the divine seer Nārada; / let all the sages listen to both as they are recited by me:

5.22.s:
bālamaṃḍanake snātvā śakreśvaramathekṣayet ..
yaḥ pumānāśvine māsi prāpte śravaṇa pañcake ..
sa pāpairmucyate sarvairājanmamaraṇādbhuvi .. 55 ..
5.22.d:
बालमंडनके स्नात्वा शक्रेश्वरमथेक्षयेत् ..
यः पुमानाश्विने मासि प्राप्ते श्रवण पञ्चके ..
स पापैर्मुच्यते सर्वैराजन्ममरणाद्भुवि .. 55 ..
5.22.m: “Having performed ritual ablution in Bālamaṇḍana and then beholding Śakreśvara, / when the five-fold Śravaṇa arrives in the month of Āśvina, / that man is freed from all sins committed on earth from birth until death.”

5.22.s:
prabhāvāttasya tīrthasya satyametaddvijottamāḥ .. 56 ..
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśīti sāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye bālamaṇḍanatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma dvāviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ..22..
5.22.d:
प्रभावात्तस्य तीर्थस्य सत्यमेतद्द्विजोत्तमाः .. 56 ..
इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीति साहस्र्यां संहितायां षष्ठे नागरखण्डे हाटकेश्वरक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये बालमण्डनतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम द्वाविंशोऽध्यायः..22..
5.22.m:
This is true, O best of brahmins, by the power of that sacred ford.
Thus ends the twenty-second chapter, titled ‘Description of the Māhātmya of the Bālamaṇḍana Sacred Ford,’ in the Māhātmya of the Hāṭakeśvara Sacred Field, in the Nāgarakhaṇḍa, the sixth [part] of the auspicious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses.

5.23.s:
sūta uvāca..
tasyaiva paścime bhāge mṛgatīrthamanuttamam..
asti puṇyatamaṃ khyātaṃ samaste dharaṇītale.....
tatra ye mānavāstīrthe samyakchraddhāsamanvitāḥ ..
caitraśuklacaturdaśyāṃ snānaṃ kurvaṃtibhāskare .. 2 ..
5.23.d:
सूत उवाच..
तस्यैव पश्चिमे भागे मृगतीर्थमनुत्तमम्..
अस्ति पुण्यतमं ख्यातं समस्ते धरणीतले.....
तत्र ये मानवास्तीर्थे सम्यक्छ्रद्धासमन्विताः ..
चैत्रशुक्लचतुर्दश्यां स्नानं कुर्वंतिभास्करे .. 2 ..
5.23.m: Sūta said: / In the western part of that very [place] there is the unsurpassed Mṛgatīrtha, / renowned on the entire surface of the earth as most sacred. / Those men who, endowed with perfect faith, / perform ritual ablution in that sacred ford on the bright fourteenth of Caitra when the sun

5.23.s:
madhye sthite na te yāṃti tiryagyonau kathaṃcana ..
api pāpasamopetā doṣaiḥ sarvaiḥ samanvitāḥ .. 3 ..
5.23.d:
मध्ये स्थिते न ते यांति तिर्यग्योनौ कथंचन ..
अपि पापसमोपेता दोषैः सर्वैः समन्विताः .. 3 ..
5.23.m: stands at midday, never go to an animal womb, / even if they are fraught with sin and endowed with all faults.

5.23.s:
kṛtaghnā nāstikāścaurā maryādābhedakāstathā ..
snātā ye tatra sattīrthe te yāṃti paramāṃ gatim ..
vimānavaramārūḍhāḥ stūyamānāśca kiṃnaraiḥ .. 4 ..
5.23.d:
कृतघ्ना नास्तिकाश्चौरा मर्यादाभेदकास्तथा ..
स्नाता ये तत्र सत्तीर्थे ते यांति परमां गतिम् ..
विमानवरमारूढाः स्तूयमानाश्च किंनरैः .. 4 ..
5.23.m: Ungrateful people, atheists, thieves, and breakers of boundaries— / having bathed there in that true sacred ford, they attain the supreme state, / mounted on excellent aerial chariots and praised by kiṃnaras.

5.23.s:
.. ṛṣaya ūcuḥ .. ..
mṛgatīrthaṃ kathaṃ tatra saṃjātaṃ sūtanaṃdana ..
kiṃ prabhāvaṃ samācakṣva paraṃ kautūhalaṃ hi naḥ .. .. 5 ..
5.23.d:
.. ऋषय ऊचुः .. ..
मृगतीर्थं कथं तत्र संजातं सूतनंदन ..
किं प्रभावं समाचक्ष्व परं कौतूहलं हि नः .. .. 5 ..
5.23.m: The seers said: / How did Mṛgatīrtha arise there, O son of Sūta? / Tell us of its power, for our curiosity is great!

5.23.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
pūrvaṃ tatra mahāraṇye nānāmṛgagaṇāvṛte ..
nānāvihaṃgasaṃghuṣṭe nānāvṛkṣasamākule .. 6 ..
5.23.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
पूर्वं तत्र महारण्ये नानामृगगणावृते ..
नानाविहंगसंघुष्टे नानावृक्षसमाकुले .. 6 ..
5.23.m: Sūta said: / Formerly, in that great forest filled with herds of various deer, / resounding with various birds, and crowded with various trees,

5.23.s:
samāyātā mahāraudrā lubdha kāścāpapāṇayaḥ ..
kṛṣṇāṃgā bhramamāṇāste yamadūtā ivā'pare .. 7 ..
5.23.d:
समायाता महारौद्रा लुब्ध काश्चापपाणयः ..
कृष्णांगा भ्रममाणास्ते यमदूता इवाऽपरे .. 7 ..
5.23.m: very terrible hunters arrived, bows in hand; / dark-bodied, wandering about, they were like other messengers of Yama.

5.23.s:
etasminnaṃtare dṛṣṭaṃ mṛgayūthaṃ taroradhaḥ ..
upaviṣṭaṃ suviśrabdhaṃ taistadā dvija sattamāḥ .. 8 ..
5.23.d:
एतस्मिन्नंतरे दृष्टं मृगयूथं तरोरधः ..
उपविष्टं सुविश्रब्धं तैस्तदा द्विज सत्तमाः .. 8 ..
5.23.m: Meanwhile, beneath a tree, a herd of deer seated / in full confidence was seen by them then, O best of brahmins.

5.23.s:
atha tām̐llubdhakāndṛṣṭvā dūrato'pi bhayāturāḥ ..
palāyanaparāḥ sarve mṛgā jagmurdrutaṃ tataḥ .. 9 ..
5.23.d:
अथ ताम्̐ल्लुब्धकान्दृष्ट्वा दूरतोऽपि भयातुराः ..
पलायनपराः सर्वे मृगा जग्मुर्द्रुतं ततः .. 9 ..
5.23.m: Then, seeing those hunters even from afar, overcome with fear, / all the deer, intent on flight, swiftly went away from there.

5.23.s:
atha te sannidhau dṛṣṭvā gaṃbhīraṃ salilāśayam ..
praviṣṭā hariṇāḥ sarve bhayārtāḥ śarapīḍitāḥ .. 6.23.10 ..
5.23.d:
अथ ते सन्निधौ दृष्ट्वा गंभीरं सलिलाशयम् ..
प्रविष्टा हरिणाः सर्वे भयार्ताः शरपीडिताः .. 6.23.10 ..
5.23.m: Then, seeing nearby a deep reservoir of water, / all the deer entered it, afflicted with fear and tormented by arrows.

5.23.s:
tatastatsalilasyāṃtaste mṛgāḥ sarva eva hi ..
mānuṣatvamanuprāptāstatprabhāvā ddvijottamāḥ .. 11 ..
5.23.d:
ततस्तत्सलिलस्यांतस्ते मृगाः सर्व एव हि ..
मानुषत्वमनुप्राप्तास्तत्प्रभावा द्द्विजोत्तमाः .. 11 ..
5.23.m: Then, inside that water, every one of those deer / attained human state by its power, O best of brahmins.

5.23.s:
atha tānmānuṣībhūtānpapracchurlubdhakā mṛgān..
mṛgayūthaṃ samāyātaṃ mārgeṇānena sāṃpratam ..
kena mārgeṇa niryātaṃ tasmādvadata mā ciram .. 12 ..
5.23.d:
अथ तान्मानुषीभूतान्पप्रच्छुर्लुब्धका मृगान्..
मृगयूथं समायातं मार्गेणानेन सांप्रतम् ..
केन मार्गेण निर्यातं तस्माद्वदत मा चिरम् .. 12 ..
5.23.m: Then the hunters questioned those deer that had become humans: / “A herd of deer arrived along this path just now. / By which path did it escape? Tell us from that, without delay!”

5.23.s:
.. mānuṣā ūcuḥ .. ..
vayaṃ te hariṇāḥ sarve mānuṣatvaṃ sudurlabham ..
tīrthasyā'sya prabhāvena prāptāḥ satyaṃ na saṃśayaḥ .. 13 ..
tacchrutvā vismayāviṣṭāstataste lubdhakā drutam ..
tyaktvā dhanūṃṣi bāṇāṃśca snānaṃ tatra pracakrire ...4..
5.23.d:
.. मानुषा ऊचुः .. ..
वयं ते हरिणाः सर्वे मानुषत्वं सुदुर्लभम् ..
तीर्थस्याऽस्य प्रभावेन प्राप्ताः सत्यं न संशयः .. 13 ..
तच्छ्रुत्वा विस्मयाविष्टास्ततस्ते लुब्धका द्रुतम् ..
त्यक्त्वा धनूंषि बाणांश्च स्नानं तत्र प्रचक्रिरे ...4..
5.23.m:
The humans said: / “We were all those deer; human state, so very hard to attain, / we have gained by the power of this sacred ford—truly, there is no doubt!”
Hearing that, overcome with amazement, those hunters immediately / discarded their bows and arrows and performed ritual ablution there.

5.23.s:
snānamātrāttataḥ sarve divyamālyānulepanāḥ ..
divyagātradharā sarve saṃjātāḥ pārthivottamāḥ .. 15 ..
5.23.d:
स्नानमात्रात्ततः सर्वे दिव्यमाल्यानुलेपनाः ..
दिव्यगात्रधरा सर्वे संजाताः पार्थिवोत्तमाः .. 15 ..
5.23.m: From the mere act of bathing, all of them became best among kings, / having divine garlands and ointments, and possessing divine bodies.

5.23.s:
.. ṛṣaya ūcuḥ .. ..
atyāścaryamidaṃ sūta yattvayā parikīrtitam ..
snānamātreṇa te prāptā lubdhakāstādṛśaṃ vapuḥ .. 16 ..
5.23.d:
.. ऋषय ऊचुः .. ..
अत्याश्चर्यमिदं सूत यत्त्वया परिकीर्तितम् ..
स्नानमात्रेण ते प्राप्ता लुब्धकास्तादृशं वपुः .. 16 ..
5.23.m: The seers said: / This is a great wonder, O Sūta, that you have related: / by the mere act of bathing, those hunters obtained such a form,

5.23.s:
tathā mānuṣyamāpannā mṛgāstoyāvagāhanāt ..
tatkathaṃ medinīpṛṣṭhe tattīrthaṃ saṃbabhūva ha .. 17 ..
5.23.d:
तथा मानुष्यमापन्ना मृगास्तोयावगाहनात् ..
तत्कथं मेदिनीपृष्ठे तत्तीर्थं संबभूव ह .. 17 ..
5.23.m: and the deer attained humanity by plunging into the water. / How then did that sacred ford come to be upon the surface of the earth?

5.23.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
liṃgabhedodbhavaṃ toyaṃ yatpurā vaḥ prakīrtitam ..
ācchannaṃ pāṃsubhiḥ kṛtsnaṃ vāyunā śakraśāsanāt .. 18 ..
5.23.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
लिंगभेदोद्भवं तोयं यत्पुरा वः प्रकीर्तितम् ..
आच्छन्नं पांसुभिः कृत्स्नं वायुना शक्रशासनात् .. 18 ..
5.23.m: Sūta said: / The water that arose from the cleavage of the liṅga, of which I told you before, / was completely covered with dust by the wind at Śakra’s command.

5.23.s:
valmīkaraṃdhramāsādya tanniṣkrāṃtaṃ punardvijāḥ ..
kālena mahatā tatra pradeśe svalpameva hi .. 19 ..
5.23.d:
वल्मीकरंध्रमासाद्य तन्निष्क्रांतं पुनर्द्विजाः ..
कालेन महता तत्र प्रदेशे स्वल्पमेव हि .. 19 ..
5.23.m: Reaching the cavity of an anthill, it emerged again, O brahmins, / after a long time, in just a small amount in that region,

5.23.s:
yatra snātaḥ purā sadyastriśaṃkuḥ pṛthivīpatiḥ ..
divyaṃ vapuḥ punaḥ prāpta ścaṃḍālatvena saṃsthitaḥ .. 6.23.20 ..
5.23.d:
यत्र स्नातः पुरा सद्यस्त्रिशंकुः पृथिवीपतिः ..
दिव्यं वपुः पुनः प्राप्त श्चंडालत्वेन संस्थितः .. 6.23.20 ..
5.23.m: where King Triśaṅku, having bathed long ago, immediately / obtained a divine form again, after having remained in the state of a caṇḍāla.

5.23.s:
etasmātkāraṇāttatra snātāḥ sāraṃgalubdhakāḥ ..
sarve pāpavinirmuktāḥ saṃprāptāḥ paramaṃ vapuḥ .. 21 ..
5.23.d:
एतस्मात्कारणात्तत्र स्नाताः सारंगलुब्धकाः ..
सर्वे पापविनिर्मुक्ताः संप्राप्ताः परमं वपुः .. 21 ..
5.23.m: For this reason, the deer and the hunters who bathed there / were all freed from sin and attained a supreme form.

5.23.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye mṛgatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmatrayoviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ .. 23 .. ..cha.. ..
5.23.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां षष्ठे नागरखण्डे हाटकेश्वरक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये मृगतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनामत्रयोविंशोऽध्यायः .. 23 .. ..छ.. ..
5.23.m: Thus ends the twenty-third chapter, titled ‘Description of the Māhātmya of the Mṛgatīrtha,’ in the Māhātmya of the Hāṭakeśvara Sacred Field, in the Nāgarakhaṇḍa, the sixth [part] of the auspicious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses.
